performance.statistic: max of three measured runs, including first run; not a p95 claim
performance.measurementBoundary: Backend TestClient import/reopen and renderer timings are proxies, not browser end-to-end timings. Linked selection, mixed-panel composition and browser memory have no implemented baseline yet; measure in owning feature phases. Targets are frozen before feature work, not achieved claims.

cache.highlight: excluded from scientific result key; highlighting cannot change results
cache.sampling: preview only; disclose original/displayed counts and algorithm; preserve extrema and group/time structure; statistics and exports use all selected valid observations

migration.phase0: No production migration and no PostgreSQL schema change.
migration.policy: Stop writers; back up SQLite with backup API plus complete object directory and hashes; verify backup opens before migration. Use transactional additive migration. Preserve ownership and IDs. Failed transaction rolls back; restore backup into a separate directory and compare data, owners and snapshot hashes before switching. Do not overwrite an open database.
migration.legacy: No sample identity inferred from row number, position, group or filename. Unknown remains null. Legacy ProjectSpec v1 and standalone 3D stay supported.
migration.postgres: Same contracts across persistence adapters; any future persistent schema change requires both SQLite and PostgreSQL adapter/migration tests. No PostgreSQL server required for local Phase 0.
